name: SeedBank
tagline: Growing better lawns. Building stronger communities.
description: SeedBank is a lawn care and landscaping company that provides reliable lawn maintenance services, including mowing, trimming, edging, cleanup, and general yard care for residential and commercial customers.

team.name: Cesar
team.title: General Manager
team.description: Oversees the overall business, coordinates the team, makes major business decisions, schedules jobs, and ensures customers receive quality service.

team.name: Weston
team.title: Finance & Accounting Manager
team.description: Manages the company’s budget, tracks revenue and expenses, prepares financial records, handles billing, and helps determine pricing for services.

team.name: Tshawn
team.title: Marketing & Sales Coordinator
team.description: Promotes SeedBank, manages advertising and social media, finds potential customers, develops promotions, and helps generate new business.

team.name: Colton
team.title: Operations Manager
team.description: Oversees lawn care jobs, equipment, and supplies. Makes sure mowing, trimming, edging, and cleanup services are completed efficiently and meet quality standards.

name: Bleu Room
tagline: Bold flavors from around the world, served in a stylish, welcoming space.
description: Bleu Room is a trendy yet cozy local restaurant serving a diverse menu of multi-cuisine favorites in a stylish, welcoming space. From comforting classics to bold international flavors, we bring the best of the world's culinary traditions straight to your table.

team.name: Marcus Spinks
team.title: General Manager
team.description: Oversees both front-of-house and kitchen to ensure fast and smooth service, hires, trains, schedules, and mentors all team members, and enforces health codes, labor laws, and safety regulations.

team.name: Yucheng Weng
team.title: Marketing Coordinator
team.description: Helps plan, execute, and track digital, social media, and print marketing campaigns, and gathers consumer data, analyzes competitor trends, and prepares summary reports.

team.name: Jack Hicks
team.title: Financial Manager
team.description: Creates balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow forecasts, monitors spending and tracks financials, and studies market conditions to find ways to cut costs and maximize profits.

team.name: Ace Doane
team.title: Floor Manager
team.description: Monitors dining room pacing, seats guests effectively, and coordinates between front-of-house staff and the kitchen, greets diners and resolves complaints on the spot, and coaches team members while enforcing dress codes and behavior standards.

name: Bubbles & Barks
industry: Service — Pet Care / Mobile Dog Grooming
tagline: Convenient, gentle dog grooming that comes to your door.
description: Bubbles & Barks is a fictional mobile dog wash and grooming business that brings pet care directly to customers. Our team travels in an equipped grooming van and provides appointments outside customers' homes, saving owners a trip to a grooming salon. Customers can choose a basic wash or a grooming package based on their dog's needs, and our goal is to provide friendly service, gentle handling, and a clean grooming environment.

team.name: Kristen Abrams
team.title: Manager
team.description: Oversees daily operations as the primary manager, assigns tasks, coordinates employee schedules and grooming appointments, and monitors service quality. Manages the budget, approves purchases, resolves customer concerns, and meets with the team to review progress and address problems.

team.name: Addy Hofmans
team.title: Sales Manager
team.description: Explains grooming services and packages to customers and helps them choose services that fit their needs. Responds to sales inquiries, follows up with interested customers, and books appointments. Tracks sales and payments, works toward sales goals, and shares customer feedback with Kristen to improve service.

team.name: Riley Denote
team.title: Marketing Coordinator
team.description: Creates social media posts, flyers, and promotions to introduce Bubbles & Barks to local dog owners. Maintains a marketing calendar and keeps service information consistent across advertising channels, and works with Addy to turn customer interest into bookings.

team.name: Harmony James
team.title: IT Support
team.description: Sets up and maintains the online booking system, business devices, and payment technology. Troubleshoots technical problems, updates website service information, manages employee account access, performs software updates and data backups, and reports unresolved issues to Kristen.

name: Pease Beez
tagline: Natural solutions for beauty and health care.
description: Pease Beez makes hand-made products from homemade honey to promote natural, whole-body health. Our mission is to recreate the beauty and health industry in an ethical and humane way, guided by our values of being natural, simple, humane, and healthy.

team.name: Emme Dressler
team.title: General Manager
team.description: Serves as Pease Beez's primary manager, overseeing daily operations, coordinating the team, and making key business decisions to keep the company running smoothly.

team.name: Tori Ross
team.title: Sales Manager
team.description: Manages customer relationships and sales channels, tracks orders, and works to grow revenue for Pease Beez's honey-based products.

team.name: Ameila Pease
team.title: Marketing Coordinator
team.description: Promotes Pease Beez through advertising and social media, and helps build awareness for the brand's natural health and beauty products.

team.name: Major Peevyhouse
team.title: Product Manager
team.description: Oversees product development and quality for Pease Beez's honey-based goods, from formulation through production standards.
